description: This file is a shell script for testing Git note management features, including creating, verifying, and comparing notes associated with commits, using fast-import and custom test functions.

methods.name: start_note_commit
methods.description: Initializes a new note commit with specific commit data and deletes previous notes.

methods.name: verify_notes
methods.description: Verifies the notes associated with commits match the expected pattern.

methods.name: test_sha1_based
methods.description: Creates notes for commits based on SHA1 hash manipulations using variable patterns.

methods.name: test_same_notes
methods.description: Creates identical notes for different commits to test consistency.

methods.name: test_concatenated_notes
methods.description: Creates multiple notes concatenated for each commit to test handling of multiple notes.

methods.name: verify_concatenated_notes
methods.description: Verifies the concatenated notes are correctly associated with commits.
